title: Skiers on Mountain Chairlift in Snowy Forest, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A high-angle black-and-white snapshot capturing skiers riding a vintage chairlift up a steep, snow-covered mountainside flanked by dense evergreen trees. The mechanical lift towers and base terminal are visible in the background valley, illustrating the post-WWII boom in recreational alpine skiing and winter resort tourism in North America.
